outside.says: Feeder minimums, fees, the operative redemption route and how it is funded stay in the feeder's offering memorandum; ADCF repurchases do not give tokenholders a direct redemption right.
The older catalogue says a 1.5% management fee with no carry; research did not review the fees.
The older catalogue says an sACRED wrapper is used for leverage loops on Morpho, Kamino and Drift Institutional; a wrapper holder's position was not reviewed and is a separate instrument.
Form D is a notice of an exempt offering, not SEC approval or the holder contract.

ingredients.label: The transfer agent's entry for my wallet, under 30 days
The underlying fund's register shows the feeder's position, under 90 days
A NAV per interest, under 2 days

verdict.summary: The feeder-into-fund chain can be outlined in v3: a T for the feeder, a register entry for the holder, and a register entry about the feeder's ADCF position. But no mint address is known, so nothing can be read; ownership-interest hides that this is a feeder interest whose liquidity depends on another fund; and which record prevails is a proposal. Most of the parties who would have to sign are unnamed, and the custodian is named only in an unlinked catalogue entry.
